title: 10 Neighborhoods, One Reason Each
description: Ten Xi’an districts, each anchored by one concrete detail from municipal-government sources.

cards.title: Xincheng District
cards.subtitle: The seat of the Shaanxi provincial government.

cards.title: Beilin District
cards.subtitle: Eight subdistricts fit within its 23.37 square kilometers.
cards.short_summary: A compact district divided into eight subdistricts.

cards.title: Lianhu District
cards.subtitle: The municipal profile records 76 heritage-architecture sites here.
cards.short_summary: A district with 76 recorded heritage-architecture sites.

cards.title: Baqiao District
cards.subtitle: The Chan, Ba and Wei rivers converge within the district.
cards.source_title: 灞桥区概况 (Baqiao District Overview) | Xi’an Municipal Government

cards.title: Chang’an District
cards.subtitle: Its municipal boundary meets Lantian, Zhashui, Huyi, Yanta, Baqiao and Weiyang.
cards.short_summary: A district adjoining six named jurisdictions.

cards.title: Huyi District
cards.subtitle: Its local administration comprises eight subdistricts and six towns.
cards.short_summary: Eight subdistricts and six towns under one district government.

cards.title: Gaoling District
cards.subtitle: The Jing River enters the Wei River in the district’s northeast.
cards.short_summary: The district containing the Jing–Wei confluence.

cards.title: Lintong District
cards.subtitle: Its 915 square kilometers are administered through 22 subdistricts.
cards.short_summary: A broad eastern district organized into 22 subdistricts.

cards.title: Yanliang District
cards.subtitle: Seven subdistricts make up this 244.5-square-kilometer district.

cards.title: Yanta District
cards.subtitle: The district covers 152 square kilometers in southern Xi’an.
cards.short_summary: A 152-square-kilometer district on the city’s south side.
